<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1603-35-51" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.212.332.122 gnod byed yod"/>
         gnyis pa ni ¦ shing 'dzin sha pa la tshad ma yin na des sha pa ma yin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod dam ma chod | 
         <l>dang po ltar na yul la <lb n="23b4"/> sha pa'i sgro 'dogs chod nas sha par nges pa na | blo sha pa'i yul can du rang gis nges pa'i phyir sha pa la ltos nas gzhan las nges su ji ltar 'gyur |</l> 
         <l>gnyis pa ltar na sha pa'i dngos po snang yang sgro 'dogs ma chod pas de la ltos nas snang la ma nges pa kho na yin pa'i phyir tshad ma tsam yang ma yin na gzhan las nges kyi tshad mar ga la 'gyur |</l>
         de la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs> na re</note>
         <mentioned>gal te shing 'dzin pa'i tshad mas sha pa'i don nges kyang tha snyad ma thogs pas <lb n="23b5"/> gzhan las nges su 'gyur ro zhe na |</mentioned></seg></TEI>
